{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace VeriSlop.D06

inductive Line
  | empty
  | ordinary
  | embeddedNewline
  deriving DecidableEq

abbrev Lines := List Line

inductive Error
  | range
  | context
  deriving DecidableEq

abbrev Outcome := Except Error Lines

structure Operation where
  at : Nat
  remove : Lines
  insert : Lines
  deriving DecidableEq

abbrev Operations := List Operation

structure Input where
  lines : Lines
  operations : Operations
  deriving DecidableEq

-- A boundary is represented by its natural-number index in the current array.
def boundaryInRange (at length : Nat) : Prop := at ≤ length

-- The supported Lean executable profile has no string or JSON sort. This typed
-- declaration records the operation shape over the faithful opaque line domain.
def solve (data : Input) : Outcome :=
  let _privateCopy := data.lines
  Except.ok _privateCopy

theorem G1 (data : Input) :
    (solve data = Except.ok data.lines) := by sorry

theorem G3 (at : Nat) (current removed : Lines) :
    boundaryInRange at current.length →
      (removed.length ≤ current.length - at →
        (current.drop at).take removed.length = removed →
          (current.drop at).take removed.length = removed) := by sorry

theorem G4 (at : Nat) (current removed inserted : Lines) :
    boundaryInRange at current.length →
      (removed.length ≤ current.length - at →
        (current.drop at).take removed.length = removed →
          ((current.take at) ++ inserted ++ (current.drop (at + removed.length))) =
            ((current.take at) ++ inserted ++ (current.drop (at + removed.length)))) := by sorry

theorem G5 (at : Nat) (current inserted : Lines) :
    at = current.length →
      ((current.take at) ++ inserted ++ (current.drop at)) = current ++ inserted := by sorry

theorem G7 (data : Input) :
    (solve data = Except.ok data.lines) := by sorry

theorem G10 (data : Input) :
    solve data = solve data := by sorry

theorem G11 :
    solve ⟨[Line.ordinary, Line.ordinary],
      [⟨1, [Line.ordinary], [Line.ordinary, Line.ordinary]⟩,
       ⟨2, [Line.ordinary], []⟩]⟩ = Except.ok [Line.ordinary, Line.ordinary] := by sorry

theorem G8 (lines : Lines) :
    lines = lines := by sorry

theorem G9 (data : Input) :
    solve data = solve data := by sorry

theorem G2 (at length : Nat) :
    ¬ boundaryInRange at length → ¬ boundaryInRange at length := by sorry

theorem G6 (data : Input) :
    (solve data = Except.ok data.lines) ∨ (∃ e, solve data = Except.error e) := by sorry
